shortDescription: Stellantis said on Tuesday that its Chinese joint venture partner Leapmotor HKEX:9863 delivered 103.129 vehicles in August, up 80.7% year-on-year.

children: Stellantis said on Tuesday that its Chinese joint venture partner Leapmotor
delivered 103.129 vehicles in August, up 80.7% year-on-year.
It is the second straight month that Leapmotor's deliveries surpass the 100.000 mark, setting a new delivery record for the fifth month in a row, Stellantis said.
Leapmotor delivered 560.883 vehicles worldwide in the first eight months of 2026, up 70.55% from the previous year, it added.
